dsdv_eng_rr_e_e1.finding: GEOM 04:44/04:45 'SRAM stack abutting the E edge, pins facing W' is infeasible: every macro LEF (ot_sram_1r1w_{64x512,128x256,512x128}_r2c2, ot_rom_4096x72_m8 and their p192/mir/escape variants) has M4 pins on BOTH W and E edges: 64x512 W = clk/ce/addr + rd_out[512] + wd_in[0:265], E = wd_in[266:511] + w_mask_in[512] + rr/cr repair (ties); 128x256 W 410 / E 409; 512x128 W 219 / E 218; ROM W = clk/ce/addr[12] + rd_out[29], E = rd_out[43]. Abutting any macro edge to another macro or the core edge strands those pins; every macro column needs a channel on BOTH sides. With M5 max and OBS M1-M4 there is no horizontal crossing of a macro.
